$comment: The Ossie commit these files were copied from, and each file's git blob id (sha1 of "blob <length>\0" + bytes, what `git ls-tree <commit> <path>` prints upstream). tests/OssiePin.test.ts recomputes each id from the bytes here and checks README.md names the same commit, so an edit to a vendored file, or a re-pin that leaves either record behind, fails (ossie-interchange#pinned-version). Moving the pin replaces the files, this record and the README's commit in one commit.
